title: Maternity and Return-Leg Protection — Caps on RideLink Alternative-Ride Claims
content:
A member stranded on the way home, and a pregnant member, have the Non-Emergency Medical Transportation alternative-ride allowance capped at a higher figure than the level's usual alternative-ride maximum.

**Rule.** The allowance is capped per late leg: a late return leg of a member whose active Medicaid Managed Care Membership is in Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care is capped at the maternity return cap of 75.00 USD; a claim where exactly one of those two holds is capped at the return cap of 60.00 USD; any other claim is capped at the level's alternative-ride maximum. A level whose alternative-ride maximum is zero offers no alternative-ride reimbursement, and every claim on it is capped at zero.

The level's alternative-ride maximum is 50.00 USD on RideLink Ambulatory Sedan and RideLink Door-to-Door Assist, and 0.00 USD on RideLink Transit Pass, RideLink Mileage Reimbursement, RideLink Wheelchair Van and RideLink Stretcher Van.

## Truth table, on a level with a maximum above zero

| Late leg is the return leg | Active membership in Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | Cap |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 75.00 USD |
| Yes | No | 60.00 USD |
| No | Yes | 60.00 USD |
| No | No | The level's alternative-ride maximum |

## Cases

*Hypothetical claims:*

- RideLink Ambulatory Sedan, late return leg, Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care, fare 80.00 USD: capped at 75.00 USD.
- RideLink Door-to-Door Assist, late outbound leg, Prairie Ridge Family Care, fare 58.00 USD: capped at 50.00 USD.
- RideLink Door-to-Door Assist, late return leg, Prairie Ridge Family Care, fare 58.00 USD: under the 60.00 USD cap, so 58.00 USD.
- RideLink Wheelchair Van, late return leg, Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care: capped at zero.
